title: Vet's tools
description: Ten chunky kid-friendly vet tools for the exam-room pegboard, each its own group whose origin is its peg point (top-centre); each hangs down (-Y), lies flat in XY with its back at z=0 and front +Z, and has a Socket_<tool>_tip at its business end. Laid out along X at 0.45 m spacing. Static, no clips.
checks: FRONT tile: ten separate tools in a row, none overlapping, all hanging down from the same top line
FRONT tile: the stethoscope reads as two ear tips on a teal Y of tubing with a loop and a round silver chest piece at the bottom
FRONT tile: the otoscope has a handle and a head with a cone pointing sideways and a pale blue lens
FRONT tile: the thermometer is a fat white stick with a red bulb at the bottom and visible scale marks
FRONT tile: the magnifier is a ring with a pale blue lens on a handle
FRONT tile: the syringe has a plunger pad, finger flange, barrel with measure lines, and a short blunt needle - friendly, not sharp
FRONT tile: the drops bottle has a rubber teat on top and a white label band
FRONT tile: the spoon has a pink blob in its bowl; the tweezers are two arms joined at the top with slightly open tips
FRONT tile: the bandage is a white roll with a hanging tail strip with a red cross; the lollipop is a swirl disc on a stick
LEFT tile: every tool is shallow (<= 8 cm) and nothing sits behind the board line z=0
diag sheet: every Socket_*_tip marker sits at its tool's business end
